name: Gate risky Airtable automation actions behind human approval

parameters.content:
## 1. Approval queue in Airtable
Use fields **Action Name**, **Action Payload**, **Approval Status**, **Requested By**, and **Requested At**. Optional audit fields: **Approved By** and **Approved At**. New requests must start as **Pending**.

## 2. Human decides outside the automation
Pending requests trigger **one internal email**. The workflow does not execute the action. A human reviews the Airtable record and changes Approval Status to **Approved** or **Rejected**.

## 3. Approved requests release once
Only **Approved** records reach the release node. Workflow static data remembers each Airtable record ID so repeated schedule runs cannot release the same request twice. Replace the final No Operation node with your real external action.

## CLEAR MERIT Internal / Working Demo
A reusable human-approval pattern for actions that can create cost, contact customers, alter important records, or trigger irreversible side effects. This is **internal operating proof, not an external client case study**. Test Pending → Rejected and Pending → Approved paths before connecting any real action.
